title: High Cabinet Temp Stage 1
shortDescription: Cabinet warmer than first alarm threshold.
fullDescription: True controllers (Lae LCD, Carel) flash HI-1 when cabinet temp exceeds the first user-set high-temp threshold for the configured delay.
whenToCallPro: True commercial sealed-system work requires an EPA-certified technician. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.a: Cabinet warmer than first alarm threshold.
Most True units mount the Lae/Carel controller behind the front grill or on the top deck for easy access.

title: Critical High Temp Alarm
fullDescription: True HI-3 escalates from HI-1/HI-2 when cabinet temperature stays above the critical alarm setpoint. Immediate action required.
symptoms: Risk of product loss if ignored

fixSteps.title: Resolve obvious cause
fixSteps.instruction: Close doors, clean condenser, confirm fans turn.

fixSteps.title: Run service diagnostic
fixSteps.instruction: Enter True service menu and read fault history; test sensors.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed component
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM True replacement, verify, clear alarm.

whenToCallPro: Sealed-system or compressor issues require EPA-certified service.

faq.q: Should I move product on a True alarm?
faq.a: On HI-3 or persistent E4, transfer perishable product to backup storage immediately.
